Title: Collapsed NIC Profile (NIOC)
Requirement: Share all traffic types across two physical uplinks with Network I/O Control shares/limits for management, vMotion, vSAN, and overlay.
Justification: Documents the 2-NIC collapsed profile so configurators can set teaming/NIOC without assuming dedicated physical functions.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldNicProfile=2; governed by DEC-NET-001, DEC-NET-003, DEC-NET-006.

Title: vSAN OSA Architecture
Requirement: Use vSAN Original Storage Architecture (OSA) with cache and capacity disk groups on certified SAS/SATA or mixed flash hardware.
Justification: Captures OSA as the selected protocol so ESA-only NVMe/single-tier requirements (CFG-003) stay inactive while HCI baseline capacity/host/policy IDs remain in force.
Mapping Rationale: Activated by hldStorageProto=VSAN_OSA; governed by DEC-STG-001, DEC-STG-002.
